title.en: Majority baseline on a different test mix
title.zh: 测试集比例变化时的多数类基线

prompt.en:
Mia sorts club emails into "event" notices and "other" messages. Her training set has 20 emails: 14 other and 6 event. Her test set has 12 emails: 5 other and 7 event.

Before training any model, she builds the majority-label baseline from the training labels and scores it on the test set. What is its test accuracy? Give a decimal to 3 places.
prompt.zh:
Mia 把社团邮件分成「活动通知」（event）和「其他消息」（other）两类。训练集有 20 封邮件：14 封 other，6 封 event。测试集有 12 封邮件：5 封 other，7 封 event。

在训练任何模型之前，她先用训练标签建立多数类基线，再在测试集上给它打分。这个基线的测试准确率是多少？答案用小数表示，保留 3 位小数。

solution.en:
Step 1: choose the rule from the training labels. other appears 14 times and event 6 times, so c* = other.

Step 2: apply it to every test email. The baseline predicts other for all 12 test emails.

Step 3: count the correct predictions. Only the 5 emails that really are other are correct, so accuracy = 5 / 12 = 0.417.

Meaning: 70% of the training emails were other, but this test set has a different mix, so the baseline is right only 41.7% of the time. Every later model must beat 0.417 on these same 12 emails.

A common slip is to pick the majority from the test labels (event, giving 7 / 12 = 0.583). That uses the test answers to build the rule.
solution.zh:
第 1 步：用训练标签选择规则。other 出现 14 次，event 出现 6 次，所以 c* = other。

第 2 步：把规则用到每一封测试邮件上。基线对全部 12 封测试邮件都预测 other。

第 3 步：数出预测正确的数量。只有真正属于 other 的 5 封是对的，所以准确率 = 5 / 12 = 0.417。

含义：训练集中 70% 的邮件是 other，但测试集的比例不同，所以这个基线只有 41.7% 的时候是对的。之后的每个模型都必须在同样这 12 封邮件上超过 0.417。

常见错误是按测试标签选多数类（选 event，得到 7 / 12 = 0.583）。这等于用测试答案来制定规则。

title.en: A split for machines nobody has seen
title.zh: 面向从未见过的机器的数据划分

prompt.en:
Iris wants to warn before a vending machine fails. Her table has 300 rows: 15 service sessions from each of 20 machines. Columns: temperature, vibration, hours since last service, technician_note (typed by the technician after a failure has been repaired), and the label failed_next_session.

Her question: will the warning work on machines that are installed next year and are not in the table? Which evaluation answers that question?
prompt.zh:
Iris 想在自动售货机出故障之前发出预警。她的表格有 300 行：20 台机器，每台 15 次维护记录。列包括：温度、振动、距上次维护的小时数、technician_note（技术员在故障修好之后填写的说明），以及标签 failed_next_session。

她的问题是：预警对明年才安装、表格里没有的机器是否有效？哪种评估方式能回答这个问题？

text.en: Split by machine: put all sessions of 14 machines in training, 3 in validation and 3 in test, and drop technician_note.
text.zh: 按机器划分：14 台机器的全部记录放进训练集，3 台放进验证集，3 台放进测试集，并删除 technician_note。

why.en: Right. Whole machines are held out, so the test machines are unfamiliar, like next year's machines. The note is written after a failure, so it is not available when the warning must be made.
why.zh: 正确。整台机器被留出，测试机器对模型是陌生的，正像明年的新机器。说明文字是在故障之后才写的，发出预警时还拿不到。

text.en: Random 70/15/15 row split, keeping every column, because random splits are unbiased.
text.zh: 按行随机 70/15/15 划分，保留所有列，因为随机划分是无偏的。

why.en: Wrong. Sessions of the same machine land in both training and test, so the test machines are not new. The note also leaks the answer, because it exists only after a failure.
why.zh: 错误。同一台机器的记录会同时出现在训练集和测试集，测试机器并不是新的。说明文字也会泄漏答案，因为它只在故障之后才存在。

text.en: Split by machine, but keep technician_note because it raises validation accuracy.
text.zh: 按机器划分，但保留 technician_note，因为它能提高验证准确率。

why.en: Wrong. A higher score from a column that is written after the failure is leakage. At prediction time the note does not exist yet.
why.zh: 错误。来自故障后才填写的列的高分就是泄漏。预测的时候这条说明还不存在。

text.en: Time split: the first 10 sessions of every machine for training, the last 5 for testing.
text.zh: 按时间划分：每台机器前 10 次记录用于训练，后 5 次用于测试。

why.en: Wrong for this question. It answers "later sessions on machines we already know". Every test machine was seen in training, so it says little about new machines.
why.zh: 对这个问题来说是错的。它回答的是「已知机器的后续记录」。每台测试机器都在训练中出现过，所以几乎说明不了新机器的情况。

title.en: Fill a gap after spotting an error code
title.zh: 识别错误代码后再填补缺口

prompt.en:
Emma's training column of room temperatures (°C) is:
21, 999, 19, missing, 24, 18

The sensor guide says 999 means "read error". Her test column is: missing, 23.

She marks error codes as missing, uses the median of the observed training values as the fill value, and keeps a separate missing flag. What value fills the missing test reading?
prompt.zh:
Emma 的训练列记录了室温（°C）：
21、999、19、缺失、24、18

传感器说明书写明 999 表示「读取错误」。她的测试列是：缺失、23。

她把错误代码标记为缺失，用训练集中观测值的中位数作为填补值，并单独保留一个缺失标记。测试列中缺失的那个读数应填入什么值？

solution.en:
Step 1: mark the error code. The training column becomes 21, missing, 19, missing, 24, 18. Two of six values are missing, so r = 2 / 6 = 0.333.

Step 2: take the observed training values and sort them: 18, 19, 21, 24. There is an even number of values, so the median is the mean of the middle two: (19 + 21) / 2 = 20.

Step 3: fill training as 21, 20, 19, 20, 24, 18 with flags 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0.

Step 4: reuse the same median for the test set. The test column becomes 20, 23 with flags 1, 0. The answer is 20 °C.

Wrong paths and what they give: keeping 999 as a real reading gives the median of 18, 19, 21, 24, 999, which is 21; recomputing a median on the test values gives 23; filling with zero gives 0 °C, a temperature nobody measured.
solution.zh:
第 1 步：标记错误代码。训练列变成 21、缺失、19、缺失、24、18。六个值中有两个缺失，所以 r = 2 / 6 = 0.333。

第 2 步：取出训练集中的观测值并排序：18、19、21、24。值的个数是偶数，所以中位数是中间两个值的平均：(19 + 21) / 2 = 20。

第 3 步：训练列填补为 21、20、19、20、24、18，缺失标记为 0、1、0、1、0、0。

第 4 步：测试集重复使用同一个中位数。测试列变成 20、23，缺失标记为 1、0。答案是 20 °C。

错误做法及其结果：把 999 当作真实读数，中位数变成 18、19、21、24、999 的中位数 21；在测试值上重新算中位数得到 23；用零填补得到 0 °C，这是谁也没有测到的温度。

prompt.en: Leon has a column "bin colour" with the values red, green and blue. He codes them red = 1, green = 2, blue = 3 and feeds the code to a k-nearest-neighbours model. Which statement is correct?
prompt.zh: Leon 有一列「垃圾桶颜色」，取值为 red、green、blue。他把它们编码为 red = 1、green = 2、blue = 3，然后把这个编码交给 k 近邻模型。下列哪项说法正确？

text.en: The codes invent an order and a spacing: blue is now 2 away from red but green is only 1 away. With one-hot columns every pair of different colours is the same distance apart, √2.
text.zh: 这种编码凭空制造了顺序和间距：blue 与 red 相距 2，而 green 只相距 1。改用独热编码后，任意两种不同颜色之间的距离都相同，都是 √2。

why.en: Right. red = [1, 0, 0] and blue = [0, 0, 1] differ in two places, so their squared distance is 2 and their distance is √2, the same as for any other pair.
why.zh: 正确。red = [1, 0, 0] 与 blue = [0, 0, 1] 有两处不同，平方距离为 2，距离为 √2，与其他任何一对颜色相同。

text.en: Integer codes are harmless for k-NN, because it only ranks distances and never uses their size.
text.zh: 整数编码对 k 近邻无害，因为它只对距离排序，从不使用距离的大小。

why.en: Wrong. The ranking is built from those invented distances, so the invented spacing changes which neighbours are chosen.
why.zh: 错误。排序正是由这些凭空制造的距离决定的，所以虚构的间距会改变选出的邻居。

text.en: One-hot encoding adds new rows, one for each colour.
text.zh: 独热编码会增加新的行，每种颜色一行。

why.en: Wrong. It adds columns (one indicator per known colour). The number of examples does not change.
why.zh: 错误。它增加的是列（每种已知颜色一个指示列），样本的行数不变。

text.en: Build the vocabulary from the training and test data together, so that no test colour is ever unknown.
text.zh: 把训练数据和测试数据合在一起建立词表，这样测试中就不会出现未知颜色。

why.en: Wrong. The vocabulary must be fitted on training data only. A colour first seen in testing needs an explicit rule, such as an unknown column.
why.zh: 错误。词表只能用训练数据拟合。测试中第一次出现的颜色需要明确的规则，例如一个未知列。

title.en: One big miss under squared error
title.zh: 平方误差下的一次大偏差

prompt.en:
Emma compares two lines that predict bus travel time on the same four held-out trips. Their residuals (prediction minus measurement, in minutes) are:

Line A: 1, −1, 1, −1
Line B: 0, 0, 0, 3

Which statement is correct?
prompt.zh:
Emma 在同样四次留出的行程上比较两条预测公交行驶时间的直线。它们的残差（预测减实测，单位：分钟）是：

直线 A：1、−1、1、−1
直线 B：0、0、0、3

下列哪项说法正确？

text.en: Line A has the lower MSE: 1 against 2.25. Squaring makes B's single 3-minute miss cost 9.
text.zh: 直线 A 的 MSE 更低：1 对 2.25。平方使 B 那一次 3 分钟的偏差贡献了 9。

text.en: Line B has the lower MSE, because three of its four predictions are exact.
text.zh: 直线 B 的 MSE 更低，因为它四个预测中有三个完全准确。

why.en: Wrong. MSE does not count exact hits. It averages squared residuals, and one large residual dominates.
why.zh: 错误。MSE 不统计「完全命中」的次数，它平均的是残差的平方，一个大的残差会占主导。

text.en: Line A has MSE 0, because its residuals cancel out: 1 − 1 + 1 − 1 = 0.
text.zh: 直线 A 的 MSE 为 0，因为它的残差相互抵消：1 − 1 + 1 − 1 = 0。

why.en: Wrong. That is the mean signed residual. Squaring each residual first is exactly what stops positive and negative errors from cancelling.
why.zh: 错误。那是带符号残差的平均值。先把每个残差平方，恰恰就是为了不让正负误差相互抵消。

text.en: RMSE would rank the lines the other way, because the square root shrinks B's large error.
text.zh: 如果用 RMSE，排序会反过来，因为平方根会缩小 B 的大误差。

why.en: Wrong. The square root is applied to the whole MSE and keeps the order: RMSE is 1 for A and 1.5 for B.
why.zh: 错误。平方根作用在整个 MSE 上，不会改变顺序：A 的 RMSE 是 1，B 的是 1.5。

title.en: One gradient step on standardised inputs
title.zh: 在标准化输入上走一步梯度下降

prompt.en:
Jack fits ŷ = w·z + b with mean squared loss L = (1/n) Σ (w zᵢ + b − yᵢ)², where z is the standardised input.

Raw training inputs x: 1, 1, 5, 5
Targets y: 1, 3, 5, 7

Standardise x with the training mean and population standard deviation. Start at w = 0 and b = 0 with learning rate η = 0.1. Compute both gradients at the old values, update both parameters, and give the new training loss.
prompt.zh:
Jack 用均方损失 L = (1/n) Σ (w zᵢ + b − yᵢ)² 拟合 ŷ = w·z + b，其中 z 是标准化后的输入。

原始训练输入 x：1、1、5、5
目标 y：1、3、5、7

用训练均值和总体标准差把 x 标准化。从 w = 0、b = 0 出发，学习率 η = 0.1。先在旧参数处同时计算两个梯度，再更新两个参数，求更新后的训练损失。

solution.en:
Standardise. The mean of x is (1 + 1 + 5 + 5) / 4 = 3. Deviations are −2, −2, 2, 2, so the population standard deviation is √((4 + 4 + 4 + 4) / 4) = 2. z = −1, −1, 1, 1.

Start. All predictions are 0, so the errors ŷ − y are −1, −3, −5, −7 and L = (1 + 9 + 25 + 49) / 4 = 84 / 4 = 21.

Gradients (n = 4, so 2/n = 0.5):
g_w = 0.5 × [(−1)(−1) + (−3)(−1) + (−5)(1) + (−7)(1)] = 0.5 × (1 + 3 − 5 − 7) = 0.5 × (−8) = −4.
g_b = 0.5 × (−1 − 3 − 5 − 7) = 0.5 × (−16) = −8.

Update together: w = 0 − 0.1 × (−4) = 0.4 and b = 0 − 0.1 × (−8) = 0.8.

New loss. For z = −1 the prediction is −0.4 + 0.8 = 0.4; for z = 1 it is 0.4 + 0.8 = 1.2. Errors are 0.4 − 1 = −0.6, 0.4 − 3 = −2.6, 1.2 − 5 = −3.8 and 1.2 − 7 = −5.8. Squares: 0.36, 6.76, 14.44, 33.64. Sum 55.2, so L = 55.2 / 4 = 13.8.

One step cut the training loss from 21 to 13.8. That checks the update rule; it says nothing yet about new data.

prompt.en: Leon's logistic-regression model is trained and fixed. He raises the decision threshold from 0.5 to 0.7 and scores the same validation set again. Which statement must be true?
prompt.zh: Leon 的逻辑回归模型已经训练好并固定下来。他把决策阈值从 0.5 提高到 0.7，并在同一个验证集上重新评分。下列哪项说法一定成立？

text.en: The predicted probabilities are unchanged, and the number of predicted positives cannot go up.
text.zh: 预测概率不变，并且被预测为正类的数量不会增加。

why.en: Right. The threshold is a separate decision rule. Any example with p ≥ 0.7 also had p ≥ 0.5, so the positive set can only shrink or stay the same.
why.zh: 正确。阈值是独立的决策规则。凡是 p ≥ 0.7 的样本也满足 p ≥ 0.5，所以正类集合只能缩小或保持不变。

text.en: Every predicted probability rises by 0.2.
text.zh: 每个预测概率都上升 0.2。

why.en: Wrong. Moving the threshold does not touch the weights or the probabilities, only the cut applied to them.
why.zh: 错误。移动阈值不会改变权重或概率，只改变作用在概率上的分界线。

text.en: Precision must go up.
text.zh: 精确率一定会上升。

why.en: Wrong. It often does, but not always: if the examples dropped (scores from 0.5 up to 0.7) contain a higher share of true positives than the ones that remain, precision falls. With no positives left it is undefined.
why.zh: 错误。它常常会上升，但并非总是如此：如果被去掉的那些 0.5 到 0.7 之间的样本中，真正例的比例高于留下的样本，精确率反而下降；如果一个正类预测都不剩，精确率就无法定义。

text.en: The model must be retrained, because its weights were fitted for a 0.5 threshold.
text.zh: 必须重新训练模型，因为它的权重是针对 0.5 的阈值拟合的。

why.en: Wrong. The weights are fitted to the training loss, not to a threshold. The same probabilities can be cut at any threshold.
why.zh: 错误。权重是根据训练损失拟合的，与阈值无关。同一组概率可以用任何阈值来切分。

title.zh: 稀有缺陷检测器的 F1

prompt.en:
Emma tests a scratch detector on 200 parts: 16 are scratched and 184 are clean. The detector flags 20 parts, and 12 of the flagged parts really are scratched.

Treat "scratched" as the positive class. What is the detector's F1 score? Give 3 decimal places.
prompt.zh:
Emma 在 200 个零件上测试一个划痕检测器：16 个有划痕，184 个完好。检测器标记了 20 个零件，其中 12 个确实有划痕。

把「有划痕」当作正类。这个检测器的 F1 分数是多少？保留 3 位小数。

solution.en:
Build the counts first.
TP = 12 (flagged and scratched). FP = 20 − 12 = 8 (flagged but clean). FN = 16 − 12 = 4 (scratched but missed). TN = 184 − 8 = 176.

Precision = 12 / 20 = 0.60. Recall = 12 / 16 = 0.75.
F1 = 2 TP / (2 TP + FP + FN) = 24 / (24 + 8 + 4) = 24 / 36 = 0.667.

For comparison, accuracy is (12 + 176) / 200 = 0.94, while the "always clean" baseline already reaches 184 / 200 = 0.92 with recall 0. Accuracy hides most of the story here; the counts and F1 show how many scratches are found and how many clean parts are sent for review.
solution.zh:
先列出计数。
TP = 12（被标记且有划痕）。FP = 20 − 12 = 8（被标记但完好）。FN = 16 − 12 = 4（有划痕却漏掉）。TN = 184 − 8 = 176。

精确率 = 12 / 20 = 0.60。召回率 = 12 / 16 = 0.75。
F1 = 2 TP / (2 TP + FP + FN) = 24 / (24 + 8 + 4) = 24 / 36 = 0.667。

作为对比，准确率是 (12 + 176) / 200 = 0.94，而「全部判为完好」的基线已经达到 184 / 200 = 0.92，召回率却为 0。在这里准确率掩盖了大部分情况；计数和 F1 才能说明找到了多少划痕、又有多少完好零件被送去复查。

title.zh: 标准化前后的 3 近邻

prompt.en:
Jack predicts whether a delivery will be late (1) or on time (0) with 3-nearest neighbours and squared Euclidean distance. The table gives five training deliveries and one query.

First he uses the raw numbers. Then he standardises both features with the training means (600 m and 4 items) and population standard deviations (200 m and 2 items). What does 3-NN predict for the query each time?
prompt.zh:
Jack 用 3 近邻和平方欧氏距离预测一次送货会迟到（1）还是准时（0）。表格给出五次训练送货和一个查询。

他先直接使用原始数值。然后用训练均值（600 米、4 件）和总体标准差（200 米、2 件）把两个特征都标准化。两种情况下，3 近邻对查询分别预测什么？

nearest-neighbours.code:
Delivery  distance (m)  items  late?
D1            300          3      0
D2            500          5      1
D3            700          7      1
D4            900          1      0
D5            600          4      0
Query         620          1      ?

text.en: Raw: late (1). Standardised: on time (0).
text.zh: 原始数值：迟到（1）。标准化后：准时（0）。

why.en: Right. Raw distances are dominated by metres, so the neighbours are D5, D3 and D2 (labels 0, 1, 1). After standardising they are D4, D5 and D1 (labels 0, 0, 0).
why.zh: 正确。原始距离被「米」主导，邻居是 D5、D3、D2（标签 0、1、1）。标准化后邻居是 D4、D5、D1（标签 0、0、0）。

text.en: Raw: on time (0). Standardised: late (1).
text.zh: 原始数值：准时（0）。标准化后：迟到（1）。

why.en: Wrong. This reverses the two results. Work out the raw neighbours first: the items column adds at most 36 to a squared distance in the tens of thousands.
why.zh: 错误。这把两个结果弄反了。先算原始邻居：件数一列最多只给以万计的平方距离增加 36。

text.en: Late (1) both times. Standardising only changes the units, so the neighbours cannot change.
text.zh: 两次都是迟到（1）。标准化只是换了单位，邻居不会变。

why.en: Wrong. Each feature is divided by a different number (200 and 2), which changes how much each feature counts in the distance, and so changes the neighbours.
why.zh: 错误。每个特征除以的数不同（200 和 2），这改变了各特征在距离中的分量，因此邻居也会改变。

text.en: On time (0) both times, because the nearest delivery D5 is on time and the nearest one decides.
text.zh: 两次都是准时（0），因为最近的 D5 是准时的，由最近的那个决定。

why.en: Wrong. That is the 1-NN rule. With k = 3 the three nearest labels vote, and in the raw case two of them are late.
why.zh: 错误。那是 1 近邻的规则。k = 3 时由最近三个标签投票，原始数值下其中两个是迟到。

solution.en:
Raw squared distances to the query (620 m, 1 item):
D1: 320² + 2² = 102404. D2: 120² + 4² = 14416. D3: 80² + 6² = 6436. D4: 280² + 0² = 78400. D5: 20² + 3² = 409.
Nearest three: D5, D3, D2 with labels 0, 1, 1. Mean 2/3 > 1/2, so the prediction is late.

Standardised. Subtracting a mean cancels inside a difference, so divide the raw differences by 200 and by 2:
D1: (320/200)² + (2/2)² = 2.56 + 1 = 3.56. D2: 0.6² + 2² = 4.36. D3: 0.4² + 3² = 9.16. D4: 1.4² + 0² = 1.96. D5: 0.1² + 1.5² = 2.26.
Nearest three: D4, D5, D1 with labels 0, 0, 0, so the prediction is on time.

Which map is "right" is a modelling choice, but the raw one silently ignores the number of items. Fit the scaling on training data and choose k on validation data.
solution.zh:
查询（620 米，1 件）的原始平方距离：
D1：320² + 2² = 102404。D2：120² + 4² = 14416。D3：80² + 6² = 6436。D4：280² + 0² = 78400。D5：20² + 3² = 409。
最近的三个是 D5、D3、D2，标签为 0、1、1。平均值 2/3 > 1/2，所以预测为迟到。

标准化后。减去均值在差值中会相互抵消，所以只需把原始差值分别除以 200 和 2：
D1：(320/200)² + (2/2)² = 2.56 + 1 = 3.56。D2：0.6² + 2² = 4.36。D3：0.4² + 3² = 9.16。D4：1.4² + 0² = 1.96。D5：0.1² + 1.5² = 2.26。
最近的三个是 D4、D5、D1，标签为 0、0、0，所以预测为准时。

哪种「地图」更合理是建模选择，但原始数值实际上悄悄忽略了件数。缩放要用训练数据拟合，k 要用验证数据选择。

title.zh: 平均概率还是统计投票？

prompt.en:
Five trees in Jack's forest give these positive-class probabilities for one new flight:

0.45, 0.45, 0.45, 0.90, 0.95

The decision threshold is 0.5. Which statement is correct?
prompt.zh:
Jack 的随机森林中有五棵树，它们对一次新的放飞给出的正类概率是：

0.45、0.45、0.45、0.90、0.95

决策阈值是 0.5。下列哪项说法正确？

text.en: Averaging gives 0.64, so the forest says positive; a majority vote of the five thresholded labels says negative (2 of 5). The combination rule must be stated.
text.zh: 取平均得 0.64，所以森林判为正类；而对五棵树先按阈值判定再多数投票，结果是负类（5 票中 2 票）。必须说明采用哪种组合规则。

why.en: Right. (0.45 × 3 + 0.90 + 0.95) / 5 = 3.2 / 5 = 0.64 ≥ 0.5. Only two trees are above 0.5 on their own, so a vote gives 2 against 3.

text.en: Both rules always agree, because they use the same five trees.
text.zh: 两种规则总是一致的，因为它们用的是同样五棵树。

why.en: Wrong. Here they disagree: averaging keeps how confident each tree is, while a vote throws that away.
why.zh: 错误。这里两者就不一致：取平均保留了每棵树的把握程度，而投票把它丢掉了。

text.en: Averaging gives 0.45, the middle value, so the forest says negative.
text.zh: 取平均得 0.45，也就是中间的那个值，所以森林判为负类。

why.en: Wrong. 0.45 is the median. The forest rule in the chapter is the mean of the probabilities, 0.64.
why.zh: 错误。0.45 是中位数。本章的森林规则是概率的平均值，即 0.64。

text.en: Both rules say positive, because the two very confident trees outweigh the other three in a vote too.
text.zh: 两种规则都判为正类，因为在投票中，两棵把握很大的树同样能压过另外三棵。

why.en: Wrong. In a vote each tree has one equal vote, whatever its confidence, so the result is 2 positive against 3 negative.
why.zh: 错误。投票时每棵树不论把握多大都只有一票，所以结果是 2 票正类对 3 票负类。

prompt.en:
Mia predicts robot task durations (minutes). Four training tasks have x = 1, 2, 3, 4 and targets y = 2, 4, 6, 12.

Start with F₀ = the training mean. Each round fits a stump to the residuals r = y − F (each leaf predicts the mean residual of its rows) and adds η = 0.5 times the stump's output.
Round 1 splits x ≤ 2 from x ≥ 3. Round 2 splits x ≤ 3 from x = 4.

What is the training MSE after round 2? Give 4 decimal places.
prompt.zh:
Mia 要预测机器人任务的耗时（分钟）。四个训练任务的 x = 1、2、3、4，目标 y = 2、4、6、12。

从 F₀ = 训练均值开始。每一轮用一个树桩拟合残差 r = y − F（每片叶子预测该叶子中各行残差的平均值），再把树桩输出的 η = 0.5 倍加到预测上。
第 1 轮把 x ≤ 2 与 x ≥ 3 分开。第 2 轮把 x ≤ 3 与 x = 4 分开。

第 2 轮之后的训练 MSE 是多少？保留 4 位小数。

solution.en:
Start. F₀ = (2 + 4 + 6 + 12) / 4 = 6. Residuals r = −4, −2, 0, 6. MSE = (16 + 4 + 0 + 36) / 4 = 14.

Round 1. Left leaf (x ≤ 2): (−4 − 2) / 2 = −3. Right leaf: (0 + 6) / 2 = 3.
F₁ = 6 + 0.5 × (−3, −3, 3, 3) = 4.5, 4.5, 7.5, 7.5.
New residuals y − F₁ = −2.5, −0.5, −1.5, 4.5. MSE = (6.25 + 0.25 + 2.25 + 20.25) / 4 = 29 / 4 = 7.25.

Round 2. Left leaf (x ≤ 3): (−2.5 − 0.5 − 1.5) / 3 = −1.5. Right leaf (x = 4): 4.5.
F₂ = F₁ + 0.5 × (−1.5, −1.5, −1.5, 4.5) = 3.75, 3.75, 6.75, 9.75.

Errors F₂ − y: 1.75, −0.25, 0.75, −2.25. Squares: 3.0625, 0.0625, 0.5625, 5.0625. Sum 8.75, so MSE = 8.75 / 4 = 2.1875.

Training MSE fell 14 → 7.25 → 2.1875. Each round repaired part of what was left. The 12-minute task pulls hard on every round because squared error weights it heavily. A falling training loss does not choose the number of rounds; watch validation error for that.

title.en: PCA after a change of units

prompt.en: Leon runs PCA on stones described by length and mass. On the training stones, the variance of length is 4 cm² and the variance of mass is 0.09 kg², with almost no covariance between them. He then records mass in grams instead of kilograms. Which statement is correct?
prompt.zh: Leon 对用长度和质量描述的石头做 PCA。在训练石头上，长度的方差是 4 cm²，质量的方差是 0.09 kg²，两者之间几乎没有协方差。随后他改用克而不是千克记录质量。下列哪项说法正确？

text.en: In kilograms the first component points along length (about 98% of the variance). In grams the mass variance becomes 90,000 g², so the first component switches to mass. Choose and state a scaling rule before PCA.
text.zh: 以千克为单位时，第一主成分沿长度方向（约占方差的 98%）。改用克之后，质量的方差变成 90,000 g²，第一主成分就转到质量方向。做 PCA 之前要选定并写明缩放规则。

why.en: Right. Variance scales with the square of the unit: 0.09 × 1000² = 90,000. Shares: 4 / 4.09 ≈ 0.978 in kilograms, and 90,000 / 90,004 ≈ 1.000 for mass in grams.

text.en: PCA does not depend on units, because it subtracts the mean before anything else.
text.zh: PCA 与单位无关，因为它先减去均值。

why.en: Wrong. Centring removes the offset, not the scale. The spread of each coordinate still depends on its unit.
why.zh: 错误。中心化去掉的是偏移，而不是尺度。每个坐标的离散程度仍然取决于它的单位。

text.en: The first component always points along the feature that best separates the rock types.
text.zh: 第一主成分总是指向最能区分岩石类型的那个特征。

why.en: Wrong. PCA never sees rock-type labels. It finds the direction of largest spread, which may be nuisance variation.
why.zh: 错误。PCA 根本看不到岩石类型的标签。它找的是离散程度最大的方向，而那可能只是无关的变化。

text.en: Changing units changes the covariance between the features but leaves each variance the same.
text.zh: 换单位会改变特征之间的协方差，但每个特征的方差保持不变。

why.en: Wrong. Multiplying mass by 1000 multiplies its variance by 1000² and the covariance by 1000.
why.zh: 错误。质量乘以 1000，其方差乘以 1000²，协方差乘以 1000。

title.zh: 余弦相似度改变了排序

prompt.en:
Emma's viewer profile is u = [2, 1, 0] over the features (astronomy, robotics, chemistry). Three videos have feature vectors:

A = [1, 0, 0]
B = [2, 1, 2]
C = [0, 1, 0]

What is the cosine similarity between B and the profile? Give 3 decimal places. (Then compare the ranking by dot product with the ranking by cosine.)
prompt.zh:
Emma 的观众画像是 u = [2, 1, 0]，三个特征依次为（天文、机器人、化学）。三个视频的特征向量是：

A = [1, 0, 0]
B = [2, 1, 2]
C = [0, 1, 0]

B 与画像之间的余弦相似度是多少？保留 3 位小数。（然后比较按点积排序与按余弦排序的结果。）

solution.en:
Length of the profile: ‖u‖ = √(4 + 1 + 0) = √5 ≈ 2.236.

B: u·B = 2×2 + 1×1 + 0×2 = 5. ‖B‖ = √(4 + 1 + 4) = 3. cos = 5 / (2.236 × 3) = 5 / 6.708 ≈ 0.745.

The other two, for the ranking:
A: u·A = 2, ‖A‖ = 1, cos = 2 / 2.236 ≈ 0.894.
C: u·C = 1, ‖C‖ = 1, cos = 1 / 2.236 ≈ 0.447.

By dot product the order is B (5), A (2), C (1). By cosine it is A (0.894), B (0.745), C (0.447). B's large chemistry tag makes it long, which helps its dot product, but it also points away from the profile, which cosine penalises. Neither score is a probability that the viewer will enjoy the video.

validation-regularization-shift.output:
A objective: 1.9
B objective: 1.5
lambda 0.0: validation MSE 1.2
lambda 0.1: validation MSE 1.0
chosen lambda: 0.1

title.en: An input change is not an accuracy measurement
title.zh: 输入变化不等于准确率测量

prompt.en: Noah monitors a message classifier. After an update to the email importer, the share of messages with a missing "sender domain" field rose from 2% to 30% within a week. No new labels have been collected yet. Which conclusion is best supported?
prompt.zh: Noah 在监控一个消息分类器。邮件导入程序更新后的一周内，缺少「发件人域名」字段的消息比例从 2% 上升到 30%。目前还没有收集任何新的标签。下列哪个结论最有依据？

text.en: The inputs have changed. Inspect the importer first, and collect fresh labels before claiming that accuracy has fallen.
text.zh: 输入发生了变化。应先检查导入程序，并在断言准确率下降之前先收集新的标签。

why.en: Right. A rise in missing values is a warning about the inputs, and a parsing fault is the first suspect. Only fresh labels can show whether the predictions got worse.
why.zh: 正确。缺失值上升是关于输入的警告，解析故障是首要嫌疑。只有新的标签才能说明预测是否变差。

text.en: Accuracy has fallen by 28 percentage points.
text.zh: 准确率下降了 28 个百分点。

why.en: Wrong. 28 points is the change in the missing-field rate, not in accuracy. Without labels the accuracy change is unknown.
why.zh: 错误。28 个百分点是字段缺失率的变化，而不是准确率的变化。没有标签就不知道准确率变了多少。

text.en: Nothing important changed, because the average predicted probability is still 0.4.
text.zh: 没有发生重要变化，因为平均预测概率仍然是 0.4。

why.en: Wrong. A stable summary of the outputs does not guarantee that individual predictions, or the input–label relationship, are unchanged.
why.zh: 错误。输出的汇总值稳定，并不能保证单个预测或输入与标签之间的关系没有变化。

text.en: Recalibrate the probabilities on the final test set straight away.
text.zh: 立即在最终测试集上重新校准概率。

why.en: Wrong. Recalibration needs separate data, and fitting it on the final test set contaminates the evaluation. The importer fault may also be the real problem.
why.zh: 错误。重新校准需要单独的数据，在最终测试集上拟合会污染评估。而且真正的问题可能是导入程序的故障。

title.en: Naive Bayes with smoothing and unequal priors
title.zh: 带平滑与不等先验的朴素贝叶斯

prompt.en:
Emma's spam filter uses multinomial naive Bayes over the vocabulary [win, prize, meeting], so V = 3. Training word counts:

spam: win 4, prize 3, meeting 0 (7 words in total)
ordinary: win 1, prize 0, meeting 5 (6 words in total)

Class priors: P(spam) = 0.3, P(ordinary) = 0.7. A new message is "win prize". Using add-one smoothing, what is the model's P(spam | message)? Give 3 decimal places.
prompt.zh:
Emma 的垃圾消息过滤器在词表 [win, prize, meeting] 上使用多项式朴素贝叶斯，所以 V = 3。训练中的词计数为：

spam：win 4，prize 3，meeting 0（共 7 个词）
ordinary：win 1，prize 0，meeting 5（共 6 个词）

类别先验：P(spam) = 0.3，P(ordinary) = 0.7。一条新消息是「win prize」。使用加一平滑，模型给出的 P(spam | 消息) 是多少？保留 3 位小数。

solution.en:
Smoothed word probabilities θ = (count + 1) / (class total + V).
spam: win (4 + 1) / (7 + 3) = 0.5; prize (3 + 1) / 10 = 0.4; meeting 1 / 10 = 0.1.
ordinary: win (1 + 1) / (6 + 3) = 2/9 ≈ 0.2222; prize (0 + 1) / 9 = 1/9 ≈ 0.1111; meeting 6/9.

Unnormalised scores for "win prize" (each word once):
spam: 0.3 × 0.5 × 0.4 = 0.06.
ordinary: 0.7 × 2/9 × 1/9 = 0.7 × 2/81 ≈ 0.01728.

Normalise: P(spam | message) = 0.06 / (0.06 + 0.01728) = 0.06 / 0.07728 ≈ 0.776.

The same in logs: spam ln 0.3 + ln 0.5 + ln 0.4 = −1.204 − 0.693 − 0.916 = −2.813; ordinary ln 0.7 + ln(2/9) + ln(1/9) = −0.357 − 1.504 − 2.197 = −4.058. exp(−2.813) / (exp(−2.813) + exp(−4.058)) gives the same 0.776.

Without smoothing, prize has probability 0 in ordinary messages, so P(spam) would be exactly 1: one unseen word would wipe out the other class. The prior of 0.7 for ordinary pulls the answer down from what equal priors would give (0.890).
solution.zh:
平滑后的词概率 θ = (计数 + 1) / (类别词总数 + V)。
spam：win (4 + 1) / (7 + 3) = 0.5；prize (3 + 1) / 10 = 0.4；meeting 1 / 10 = 0.1。
ordinary：win (1 + 1) / (6 + 3) = 2/9 ≈ 0.2222；prize (0 + 1) / 9 = 1/9 ≈ 0.1111；meeting 6/9。

「win prize」的未归一化得分（每个词出现一次）：
spam：0.3 × 0.5 × 0.4 = 0.06。
ordinary：0.7 × 2/9 × 1/9 = 0.7 × 2/81 ≈ 0.01728。

归一化：P(spam | 消息) = 0.06 / (0.06 + 0.01728) = 0.06 / 0.07728 ≈ 0.776。

用对数计算结果相同：spam 为 ln 0.3 + ln 0.5 + ln 0.4 = −1.204 − 0.693 − 0.916 = −2.813；ordinary 为 ln 0.7 + ln(2/9) + ln(1/9) = −0.357 − 1.504 − 2.197 = −4.058。exp(−2.813) / (exp(−2.813) + exp(−4.058)) 同样得到 0.776。

如果不做平滑，prize 在 ordinary 中的概率是 0，P(spam) 就会恰好等于 1：一个没见过的词就能抹掉另一个类别。ordinary 的先验 0.7 把答案往下拉了；如果两个先验相等，结果会是 0.890。
